section_summary: This section opens with the conclusion of SCAP Circular No. 8, establishing entry, transportation, customs, quarantine, and vessel-control rules for occupied Japan. The remaining records concern diplomatic, missionary, commercial, and official travel applications, military clearances, permit extensions, documentary waivers, and proposed repatriations. Prominent cases involve Alejandro Toussieh, a Philippine diplomatic party, Argentine-sponsored passengers, Pakistani traders, missionaries, and several private business representatives.

subfiles.title: SCAP Circular No. 8: Entry and Exit Control Regulations
subfiles.from: Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.to: Foreign governments, diplomatic representatives, and occupation authorities
subfiles.about: Regulations governing individual, aircraft, merchant-vessel, and combatant-ship entry into and departure from Japan.
subfiles.summary: The concluding portions prescribe entry documentation, baggage declarations, immunizations, quarantine, permits, aircraft clearances, and controls on merchant and combatant vessels. They also require advance cargo approval and operational reporting in Japanese waters. The circular ends with the signatures of Paul J. Mueller and John B. Cooley.

subfiles.title: Letter forwarding two applications for entry to Japan
subfiles.about: Forwards two Japan-entry applications and requests notification of the military decision.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards two applications and asks the Military Permit Section to report SCAP's decision.

subfiles.title: Action slip for travel to Japan
subfiles.about: Records action on an incompletely identified Japan travel case.
subfiles.summary: Action slip records military handling of an applicant whose name and remarks are largely illegible.

subfiles.title: Memorandum approving Armand J. Jacques's missionary travel
subfiles.about: Reports theater clearance for Jacques and permission to ship household goods and supplies.
subfiles.summary: Jacques is cleared as a missionary and may ship household effects plus one ton of food and maintenance supplies.

subfiles.title: Application of Rudolf Riese to visit Japan
subfiles.about: Requests commercial travel to Japanese cities for nonferrous-metal purchases, processing arrangements, and sales.
subfiles.summary: Riese applies to visit four cities for metals purchases, Chinese-ore conversion, sales, and completion of existing orders.

subfiles.title: Translation of Panamanian note concerning Alejandro Toussieh
subfiles.about: Transmits Toussieh's application and asks to be advised of the decision.
subfiles.summary: The Panamanian Embassy submits Toussieh's application and requests timely notice of the result.

subfiles.title: Spanish original of Panamanian note concerning Alejandro Toussieh
subfiles.about: Spanish original transmitting Toussieh's Japan travel application.
subfiles.summary: Spanish-language original of the Panamanian Embassy's request concerning Toussieh.

subfiles.title: Application of Alejandro Toussieh to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Requests entry to Japan for commercial purposes.
subfiles.summary: Toussieh applies as a merchant and importer-exporter; much of the purpose and itinerary is illegible.

subfiles.title: Memorandum requesting additional information on Toussieh's proposed trade
subfiles.about: Seeks details about the goods in which Toussieh intends to trade before further military review.
subfiles.summary: State reports that military authorities require clarification of the goods Toussieh wishes to handle before reconsidering his application.

subfiles.title: Letter forwarding Alejandro Toussieh's application
subfiles.about: Sends Toussieh's Panamanian application to the Military Permit Section for SCAP consideration.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards Toussieh's application and requests notification of SCAP's decision.

subfiles.title: Letter concerning requested information on Toussieh
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the Army's request for further information about Toussieh's proposed trip.
subfiles.summary: Chappell promises to forward the requested clarification when it is received.

subfiles.title: Action slip requesting more information on Alejandro Toussieh
subfiles.about: Requests additional information before Toussieh's application can be referred to theater authorities.
subfiles.summary: The Army requests more information about Toussieh's proposed commercial activity.

subfiles.title: Follow-up action slip on Alejandro Toussieh
subfiles.about: Asks for a reply to the Military Permit Section's memorandum of March 8.
subfiles.summary: Scott requests an answer to the outstanding March 8 inquiry about Toussieh.

subfiles.title: Blank Department of State charge-out form
subfiles.about: Blank form for recording removal of documents from departmental files.
subfiles.summary: Blank State Department charge-out form with no completed entries.

subfiles.title: Blank Department of State charge-out form
subfiles.about: Second blank form for recording removal of documents from departmental files.
subfiles.summary: Second blank State Department charge-out form with no completed entries.

subfiles.title: Airgram to São Paulo concerning Gerhardt Thore
subfiles.about: Reports Thore's transfer to the Catholic University in Tokyo and addresses his travel authorization.
subfiles.summary: State reports that Jesuit missionary Gerhardt Thore has been transferred from São Paulo to Tokyo and discusses permission for his travel.

subfiles.title: Swiss Legation request concerning Max Graessli
subfiles.about: Requests agrément and an entry permit for Switzerland's designated diplomatic representative in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Swiss Legation requests prompt American agreement to Graessli's appointment and issuance of the permit needed to enter Japan.

subfiles.title: Iranian acknowledgment concerning Hussein Touty
subfiles.from: Minister and Chargé d'Affaires ad interim of Iran
subfiles.about: Acknowledges notice that Touty's authorized commercial stay in Japan was extended.
subfiles.summary: Iran acknowledges Touty's extension and his stated intention to leave Japan on February 9.

subfiles.title: State Department reply on Max Graessli's appointment
subfiles.from: Norman Armour, for the Secretary of State
subfiles.about: Accepts Graessli's appointment but explains that SCAP must authorize his entry.
subfiles.summary: State raises no objection to Graessli's appointment. Because the Swiss mission in Tokyo has already approached SCAP, no further departmental action is necessary; SCAP clearance and the prescribed statement will constitute his entry authority.

subfiles.title: Conversation on Armand Jacques's clearance
subfiles.about: Records notification to the Canadian Embassy that Jacques had been cleared for missionary travel.
subfiles.summary: La Vigne agrees that the Canadian Embassy will document Jacques under SCAP Circular No. 8 without written confirmation.

subfiles.title: Permit extension for Jacob Shriro
subfiles.about: Grants an extension of Shriro's Japan entry period through February 15.
subfiles.summary: Military permission extends Shriro's permitted entry period from February 1 through February 15.

subfiles.title: Record-copy replacement notice
subfiles.about: Directs return of an attached telegram or airgram record copy to central files.
subfiles.summary: Notice explains that the white copy replaces a missing yellow record copy.

subfiles.title: Incoming airgram cover sheet
subfiles.about: Preprinted cover for an incoming State Department airgram.
subfiles.summary: Incoming-airgram cover sheet without legible message text.

subfiles.title: Incoming airgram permanent-record sheet
subfiles.about: Permanent-record sheet for an incoming airgram whose message text is absent.
subfiles.summary: Permanent-record airgram sheet bearing filing and declassification markings but no legible message.

subfiles.title: Letter from Mohamed Adib Bestani requesting business travel
subfiles.about: Submits duplicate applications and a Syrian passport for a trade-revival trip to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Bestani requests approval for a business trip intended to revive Syrian-Japanese trade relations.

subfiles.title: Reply returning Bestani's passport and applications
subfiles.about: Explains that Bestani must apply through Syrian diplomatic channels and returns his documents.
subfiles.summary: State directs Bestani to submit his request through the Syrian Legation and returns his passport and duplicate applications.

subfiles.title: Incoming airgram permanent-record cover
subfiles.about: Permanent-record cover for an incoming airgram with illegible message text.
subfiles.summary: Incoming-airgram record sheet containing filing annotations but no recoverable message.

subfiles.title: Telegram authorizing handling of Argentine-sponsored passengers
subfiles.to: Office of the United States Political Adviser, Yokohama
subfiles.about: Lists proposed Granadero passengers and authorizes their handling subject to local clearance.
subfiles.summary: State has no objection to arranging the listed passengers' departure on the Argentine steamer Granadero if local clearance is obtained.

subfiles.title: Translation of Argentine request for passenger departures
subfiles.about: Requests assistance assembling seven named persons in Yokohama for departure aboard the Granadero.
subfiles.summary: Argentina asks occupation authorities to facilitate the travelers' departure at their own expense and requests telegraphic action because the ship will sail near month's end.

subfiles.title: Spanish original of Argentine request for passenger departures
subfiles.about: Spanish original requesting assistance for passengers departing Japan aboard the Granadero.
subfiles.summary: Spanish-language original lists the prospective passengers and asks that they be assembled in Yokohama for repatriation.

subfiles.title: Routing sheet for Philippine delegation applications
subfiles.about: Routes material relating to a Philippine group's proposed travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Routing sheet identifies the February 5 file concerning Philippine travel applications.

subfiles.title: Enclosure note for Philippine delegation applications
subfiles.about: Transmits duplicate application forms for members of a traveling group.
subfiles.summary: The note states that duplicate application forms are enclosed for each group member.

subfiles.title: Application of Joaquin M. Elizalde to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Requests a two-day official visit to Tokyo by the Philippine Ambassador.
subfiles.summary: Elizalde applies to fly from the United States to Tokyo on official business on February 14.

subfiles.title: Application of Carmen Lopez Horton to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Requests entry to accompany the Philippine Ambassador on official business.
subfiles.summary: Horton applies for a two-day Tokyo visit as the Ambassador's secretary.

subfiles.title: Application of Emiliano D. Reyes to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Requests entry to accompany the Philippine Ambassador on official business.
subfiles.summary: Reyes applies for a two-day Tokyo visit as a Philippine government employee.

subfiles.title: Application of Tomas G. de Castro to enter Japan
subfiles.to: Secretary of the Joint Chiefs of Staff
subfiles.about: Requests entry to accompany the Philippine Ambassador on official business.
subfiles.summary: De Castro applies for a two-day Tokyo visit as Second Secretary of the Philippine Embassy.

subfiles.title: Letter requesting permits for the Philippine Ambassador's party
subfiles.about: Requests urgent military permission for Ambassador Elizalde and three accompanying staff members.
subfiles.summary: Chappell forwards four applications, urges immediate attention, and states that the Department favors the Philippine delegation's official visit.

subfiles.title: Incoming telegram action copy
subfiles.about: Action copy of an incoming telegram whose body is absent.
subfiles.summary: Telegram action sheet records receipt on February 5 but contains no message text.

subfiles.title: Letter requesting revised Japan-entry guidance
subfiles.about: Requests the forthcoming release on relaxed Japan-entry restrictions for Everett W. Frazar.
subfiles.summary: Schmid cites a newspaper report and asks for the formal entry-policy release for himself and Frazar.

subfiles.title: Reply enclosing Japan-entry press release
subfiles.about: Provides the February 3 press release explaining revised procedures for travel to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Whitman encloses Press Release No. 89 and notes that Frazar received another copy at his Florida address.

subfiles.title: Memorandum requesting clarification of Brazilian ophthalmology mission
subfiles.about: Requests clarification of Meirelles and de Abreu Lima's alleged Japan mission connected with an ophthalmology congress.
subfiles.summary: Theater headquarters knows of no Japanese mission tied to the Havana congress and requests clarification before further action.

subfiles.title: Memorandum to Brazil seeking clarification of proposed Japan visit
subfiles.about: Explains the Army's doubts and seeks further information on the delegates' proposed commercial and ophthalmological mission.
subfiles.summary: State recounts the applicants' claimed connection with the Havana congress and their intended study of cereal imports into Japan. It asks Brazil to clarify how the congress relates to the Japanese trip.

subfiles.title: Transfer sheet for Argentine Embassy correspondence
subfiles.about: Records transfer of three Argentine passenger-related communications to another file number.
subfiles.summary: Transfer sheet lists an Argentine note, State reply, and Yokohama instruction moved on March 18.

subfiles.title: Note directing Pakistani applicants to British channels
subfiles.about: Directs Shaukat Omar and Sayed Saigel to seek SCAP permission through British diplomatic channels.
subfiles.summary: State explains that applications from countries whose Japanese interests are protected by another power must use that protecting power's facilities. Omar and Saigel therefore require advance SCAP approval through British channels.

subfiles.title: Routing sheet for note to the Pakistani Embassy
subfiles.to: Division of Occupied Areas Economic Affairs
subfiles.about: Routes a proposed note concerning Pakistan's trade representative.
subfiles.summary: Internal routing sheet for the March 1 note to the Embassy of Pakistan.

subfiles.title: Reply concerning a Pakistani trade representative
subfiles.about: Explains how Pakistan may seek entry for a trade representative despite lacking its own mission in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Because Great Britain protects Pakistani interests in Japan, an application normally should pass through British channels. State nevertheless offers to transmit it if Pakistan supplies the representative's name and full travel details.

subfiles.title: Incoming telegram action copy
subfiles.about: Action copy for an incoming telegram whose body is absent.
subfiles.summary: Incoming-telegram cover carries filing marks but no recoverable message.

subfiles.title: Letter forwarding application of Husain H. Ahmed
subfiles.about: Quotes Karachi's application for Ahmed's commercial visit and requests submission to SCAP.
subfiles.summary: Ahmed seeks sixty days in Kobe and Tokyo to inspect his prewar office and investigate trade in textiles, chemicals, and hardware.

subfiles.title: Office memorandum on Archibald S. R. Williamson
subfiles.about: Transmits Williamson's military permit and identifies him as a British businessman then in Manila.
subfiles.summary: Shipley attaches Permit 7145 and identifies Williamson as a British representative of Balfour, Guthrie & Co.

subfiles.title: Telegram notifying Shanghai of Manuel Sternberg's clearance
subfiles.about: Reports Sternberg's Japan-entry clearance and instructs the consul to furnish a certified copy.
subfiles.summary: Sternberg may enter Japan between February 9 and 29, remain twenty-one days, and carry two passport photographs.

subfiles.title: Memorandum reporting Manuel Sternberg's clearance
subfiles.about: Reports military clearance for Sternberg and asks State to notify the proper agent.
subfiles.summary: The Army clears Sternberg for entry during February 9–29 and a twenty-one-day stay.

subfiles.title: Receipt for Philippine delegation military permits
subfiles.about: Acknowledges receipt of four numbered military permits for the Philippine Ambassador's party.
subfiles.summary: De Castro acknowledges permits 7170–7173 for Elizalde, himself, Reyes, and Horton.

subfiles.title: Conversation on delivery of Philippine delegation permits
subfiles.about: Records de Castro's receipt of four permits and verification of Horton's U.S. passport.
subfiles.summary: De Castro collected the permits; Corkran then arranged to annotate Horton's permit with her valid passport number.

subfiles.title: Exit-permit waiver for Emiliano D. Reyes
subfiles.about: Records telephonic waiver of Reyes's exit-permit requirement.
subfiles.summary: The Visa Division waives Reyes's exit permit for his February 12 Northwest Airlines departure from Minneapolis.

subfiles.title: Exit-permit waiver for Tomas G. de Castro
subfiles.about: Records telephonic waiver of de Castro's exit-permit requirement.
subfiles.summary: The Visa Division waives de Castro's exit permit for his February 12 Northwest Airlines departure from Minneapolis.

subfiles.title: Telegram notifying Manila of Williamson's clearance
subfiles.about: Reports Archibald Williamson's SCAP clearance and documentation requirements.
subfiles.summary: Williamson may enter Japan between February 9 and 29, stay twenty-one days, and carry two passport photographs.

subfiles.title: Conversation on communicating Williamson's clearance
subfiles.about: Records agreement to cable Williamson's clearance to Manila and return the paper permit to the Army.
subfiles.summary: Captain Rawls confirms that a cable to Manila is sufficient documentation and requests return of the military permit.

subfiles.title: Conversation on Ben S. Goldberg's postponed travel
subfiles.about: Records Commerce Department notice that Goldberg postponed his Japan trip.
subfiles.summary: Goldberg's company address is identified, but his permit will be returned because he postponed travel.
